load_ade20k_panoptic_json: load ADE20K panoptic JSON annotations into Detectron2 standard dataset format with image and label paths
register_ade20k_panoptic: register an ADE20K panoptic segmentation dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for a given split
get_metadata: get ADE20K metadata including thing and stuff class names, colors, and dataset-to-contiguous ID mappings
register_all_ade20k_panoptic: register all predefined ADE20K panoptic train and validation splits under a given dataset root directory
ADE20K_150_CATEGORIES: access the list of 150 ADE20K category definitions with names, colors, IDs, and thing or stuff labels
